name: Almora
pageLabel: Kasar Devi and the Almora hills
blurb: A ridge-top town of stone lanes and temples, and the heart of Kumaoni food and craft.
culture: Chitai Golu Devta temple, where devotees hang brass bells
Aipan, the Kumaoni floor and wall art made with rice paste and red clay
Baithaki Holi, a Kumaoni tradition of sung Holi
food: Bal mithai and singori, the town's famous sweets
Bhatt ki churkani and aloo ke gutke

travel.reach: Nearest railhead is Kathgodam, about 3 hours up the hill.
travel.best: March to June and September to November.
travel.tip: Kasar Devi sunrise and the Jageshwar temples make a good two-day loop.

name: Lansdowne
blurb: A quiet cantonment town of oak and pine, home to the Garhwal Rifles regimental centre.
culture: Garhwal Rifles Regimental Centre and its museum
St Mary's Church and the cantonment's colonial buildings
Village life around Bansi and Ghildiyal Gaon
food: Kafuli and chainsoo, classic Garhwali dishes
Jhangora and mandua, the hill millets

travel.reach: Nearest railhead is Kotdwar, roughly 40 km away.
travel.tip: Bhulla Tal lake is an easy walk; keep hill-road driving to daylight.

name: Nainital
blurb: A lake town wrapped in hills, and the usual gateway to Kumaon.
culture: Naina Devi Temple on the lake's north shore
Boating on Naini Lake and the Mall Road promenade
food: Bhatt ki churkani and Kumaoni thali

travel.best: March to June and September to November.
travel.tip: Weekends and holidays are crowded; weekdays are calmer.

name: Kainchi Dham
blurb: The ashram of Neem Karoli Baba, between Nainital and Almora.
culture: Neem Karoli Baba ashram, visited by pilgrims from India and abroad
The annual fair on 15 June draws very large crowds
food: Simple dhabas along the Nainital to Almora road

travel.reach: About 17 km from Nainital on the Almora road.
travel.best: Outside the mid-June fair for a quiet visit.
travel.tip: Check traffic before the fair; roads back up.

name: Jageshwar
blurb: A cluster of ancient stone temples in a deodar forest.
culture: A large group of old Shiva temples in a forest valley
Temple architecture of the Kumaon hills
food: Tea and simple meals at stalls near the temples

travel.best: Mornings and the months outside the monsoon.
travel.tip: Pair it with Katarmal Sun Temple on one guided day.

name: Ranikhet
blurb: A cantonment hill station with wide pine walks and long Himalayan views.
culture: Home of the Kumaon Regiment
Jhula Devi temple, known for its many bells

travel.best: March to June and September to November.
travel.tip: Combine with Kausani and Almora on a Kumaon circuit.

name: Kausani
blurb: A ridge village with a wide view of the Himalayan snow peaks.
culture: Anasakti Ashram, linked to Mahatma Gandhi's stay
Birthplace of the poet Sumitranandan Pant

travel.reach: By road from Kathgodam or Almora.
travel.best: October to March for clear views.
travel.tip: Sunrise is the main event; book a room facing the peaks.

name: Mussoorie
blurb: The 'Queen of the Hills', with Landour's quiet lanes above the Mall.
culture: Landour and its old bungalows
A long literary and colonial history
food: Cafe culture in Landour and the Mall

travel.best: March to June and September to November.
travel.tip: Walk Landour on a weekday morning.

name: Dehradun
blurb: The state capital, with rail and air links and the largest cluster of incubators.
culture: Forest Research Institute campus
Tapkeshwar Temple, a cave shrine

travel.reach: Rail and Jolly Grant airport serve the city.
travel.tip: A practical base for meetings and the Mussoorie and Rishikesh trips.

name: Rishikesh
blurb: The yoga town on the Ganga, with rafting and evening aarti.
culture: Ganga aarti at Triveni Ghat
Laxman Jhula and the yoga ashrams

travel.reach: About 25 km from Jolly Grant airport.
travel.best: September to November and February to April.
travel.tip: Rafting stretches close in the monsoon.

name: Haridwar
blurb: A pilgrimage city where the Ganga leaves the hills.
culture: Ganga aarti at Har ki Pauri
One of the sites of the Kumbh Mela
food: Kachori and sweets in the old bazaar

travel.reach: Major railhead on the Delhi line.
travel.tip: Evenings at the ghat are busy; arrive early.

name: Jim Corbett National Park
blurb: India's oldest national park, around Ramnagar.
culture: Established in 1936, with a long conservation history

travel.reach: About 60 km from Kathgodam; Ramnagar is the base.
travel.best: November to June; some zones close in the monsoon.
travel.tip: Safari permits sell out in peak months; book early.

name: Auli
blurb: A meadow-and-ski resort above Joshimath with views of Nanda Devi.
culture: Gateway to the Garhwal high Himalaya

travel.best: Winter for snow; spring and autumn for views.
travel.tip: Road conditions change quickly; check before you go.

name: Kedarnath
blurb: The Shiva shrine at the head of the Mandakini valley, reached on foot or by helicopter, open only in the warmer months.
culture: One of the Char Dham shrines of Shiva
The season opens in spring and closes before winter
food: Simple pilgrim meals along the route

travel.reach: Road to Gaurikund from Rishikesh, then a trek or helicopter.
travel.best: Check official opening dates each year.
travel.tip: Register for the yatra and keep buffer days for weather.

name: Badrinath
blurb: The Vishnu shrine on the Alaknanda, reachable by road, open only in the warmer months.
culture: One of the Char Dham shrines of Vishnu
Mana, the last village before the Tibet border
food: Simple pilgrim meals along the route

travel.best: Check official opening dates each year.
travel.tip: Landslides can close the road; keep buffer days.

name: Munsiyari
blurb: A far-eastern Kumaon village facing the Panchachuli peaks.
culture: Johar valley traditions and a tribal heritage museum

travel.reach: A long road journey from Kathgodam, often over two days.
travel.best: April to June and September to November.
travel.tip: Plan buffer days; mountain roads can close.
